cashless_bundling_regulations.rule_1_mandatory_bundling: All admission, nursing, doctor rounds, standard diagnostics, routine consumables (gloves, syringes, needles, cotton, spirit, IV sets, cannulas), inpatient medicines, and dietary food are 100% bundled into package rates. Charging any separate fees to PM-JAY cardholders is strictly illegal under Section 4.2 of the NHA Empanelment Agreement.
cashless_bundling_regulations.rule_2_implant_caps: Implants can only be billed if notified in the HBP package and are strictly capped at NPPA/NHA ceiling limits. Any surcharge, margin markup, or brand substitution charge is a direct statutory violation.
cashless_bundling_regulations.rule_3_diagnostics: Diagnostics performed within 3 days prior to admission related to the treated condition must be reimbursed or bundled into the package; separate cash billing of pre-op ultrasound, blood work, or ECG is prohibited.
cashless_bundling_regulations.rule_4_post_discharge: Hospitals must dispense 15 days of essential take-home medications at discharge without demanding out-of-pocket cash from the beneficiary.
cashless_bundling_regulations.rule_5_tier_adjustments: Tier 1 rates apply to Metro cities / NABH full accreditation. Tier 2 applies to Tier-II cities. Tier 3 applies to non-metro districts. Hospitals cannot bill Tier 1 rates if not officially accredited as Tier 1 by the State Health Agency.
